_doc: Figures a table's spec puts at one place that belong to another, moved after extraction (extract.claims). Mostly Kwantung: the empire-wide tables and statistical yearbooks print the Kwantung Leased Territory and the South Manchuria Railway Zone together (關東州及滿鐵附屬地), often headed just 關東州 / Kwantung, until the zone passed to Manchukuo (1 Dec. 1937). Keys: t (slug:id), from, to, optional from_year/until (years moved, inclusive), why. Printed names of the combined unit are matched by places/aliases.json.
